title: cli-contract's kind registry says lore init emits 'init'; the code emits 'init.result'
description:
Found incidentally by an adversarial reviewer during PR #140 (LCLI-467), while checking that PR's envelope against the contract. Pre-existing, untouched by that PR, and it affected nothing there -- filed because the contract document is the normative machine-facing spec and a consumer branching on `kind` would be reading a wrong table.

reference/cli-contract section 2.1's `kind` registry lists `init` for `lore init`. The code emits `init.result`:
  - src/core/manifest.ts
  - src/commands/init.ts
  - test/init.test.ts asserts init.result

So the document and the implementation disagree about a value external consumers are explicitly invited to branch on.

DECIDE WHICH IS WRONG rather than making them match blindly: if `init.result` is correct, the contract's registry needs the correction and the change is documentation-only; if `init` is correct, changing the emitted kind is a BREAKING change to a machine surface and needs the contract's own compatibility rules applied. Check whether any other kind in that registry has drifted the same way while in there -- one divergence in a hand-maintained table is rarely alone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/reference/cli-contract.md section 2.1 registry rows for `init` and `new` read `init.result` and `new.result` (matching src/core/manifest.ts), docs/reference/cli-surface.md init Output cell reads `kind: init.result`, and test/lcli528-kind-registry-matches-manifest.test.ts fails RED when any section 2.1 command kind is not manifest-declared.

plan: 1. Claim LCLI-528 and branch docs/LCLI-528-cli-contract-init-new-kinds from origin/dev.
2. Run opum-workflow:implement-assignment to correct cli-contract section 2.1 init/new registry rows (and the identical cli-surface init Output cell) and add the recurrence test.
3. Independent read-only opum-workflow:review-assignment on the result, plus my own RED/GREEN proof of the test and the full gate runs.
4. Push, open the PR to dev, wait for required checks green on the exact head, squash-merge, complete the task, delete the local branch.
implementationNotes: DEC-160 (opum-doc, accepted 2026-10-05), read by ref from opum-doc origin/dev: the CODE is right and the docs were wrong. Corrected docs/reference/cli-contract.md section 2.1 kind cells `init` -> `init.result` and `new` -> `new.result`; and the identical wrong kind in docs/reference/cli-surface.md (`lore init` Output cell `kind: init` -> `kind: init.result`). Documentation-only, non-breaking; no source changed.

Added test/lcli528-kind-registry-matches-manifest.test.ts: every kind the section 2.1 table attributes to a lore command must be in buildManifest() union (commands[].kind, commands[].resultKinds, globalFlags[].kind). RED/GREEN proof by the teammate: reverting the init row to bare `init` reddens it (2 fail, exit 1, undeclared=[init]); restoring greens it (2 pass, exit 0).
